title: Clinical Trial of Osteoporosis in Ankylosing Spondylitis
brief_summary: This is an observational study aiming to study the prevalence and risk factors for osteoporosis and vertebral fractures in patients with ankylosing spondylitis attending three Rheumatology clinics in Western Sweden.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Definitive Ankylosing spondylitis according to the New York criteria
* At least 18 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant
* Dementia
* Not able to understand, speak or read Swedish
study_population: Patients with definitive ankylosing spondylitis attending three rheumatology clinics in Western Sweden.
